text:
maria: Uploaded signed installer bundle for rc-2026-03-15 to private-s3. Need final delivery window + checksum ack.

maria: Artifacts: rc-2026-03-15.tar.gz, installer-v2.1.0.bin, images-archive-v2.1.0.tar.xz

maria: Cosign sigs attached, signing key referenced: cosign:key-20260309 (KMS). Checksums below — verify before shipping: 

maria: ```
rc-2026-03-15.tar.gz  sha256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41f7e5d5be8b2a6f5f2a1c3d6f7a
installer-v2.1.0.bin sha256: 9a12f4b6c3d5e1f8a7b0c29d6e4f3a1b8c2d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7
images-archive-v2.1.0.tar.xz sha256: a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0
```

devops-bot: Deploy window suggestion: 2026-03-16 22:00-23:30 UTC (private/VPC only). Canary target: 3 nodes in eu-west-1. :calendar:

oliver: Quick Q — which cosign key id did you use? we rotated on 03/09. Want to ensure recipients have the right public key.

seema: I verified using cosign v1.14 against cosign:key-20260309 public. Signature OK. Ran quick extraction of manifest for installer.

josh: Docs note: on-prem install guide updated with new flags for airgap extraction (--airgap-extract-dir). I uploaded a tiny how-to to the release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/rc-2026-03-15

qa-bot: Canary smoke test results expected after deploy-bot canary-up. Will post pass/fail alerts here.

maria: One blocker from packaging: images-archive contains a new liveness probe change that might increase memory on startup. We should canary and watch mem RSS.

seema: Ran e2e on dedicated staging-canary (3 nodes). One node showed OOM in the first 90s under synthetic load. Not a full failure but higher memory churn. I recommend holding full rollout until we confirm memory profile. @maria @oliver :eyes:

oliver: If we hold, option A: pin images to previous stable image tag images:v2.0.9 and ship installer that references pinned tag. Option B: proceed but reduce canary to single node and lengthen monitoring window. I prefer A for safety.

maria: Agree with pinning. We'll update the bundle to reference images:v2.0.9 and re-sign. That buys us time to root-cause probe memory regression.

josh: If we re-pin, please update release notes and the airgap README with the old image tag so customers who prefetch artifacts know which images to expect. I'll handle doc patch once artifacts are re-uploaded.

devops-bot: Noted: hold full rollout. Scheduled hold outreach to channel if window approaches.

maria: Action items: 1) repack bundle with image tag images:v2.0.9 (maria), 2) re-sign with cosign:key-20260309 (maria), 3) QA run extended canary smoke for 30m (seema/qa-bot), 4) docs update (josh). ETA 90m.

seema: Started extended canary now on staging. Will report memory traces + heap dumps if we see OOM.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy start recorded at 1846012450. Target: staging-canary-3. Will post pass/fail.

qa-bot: First 10m smoke: service up, but one pod restarted once at ~120s with OOMKilled. Collecting logs.

maria: Repack done, re-signed, new checksums: ```
rc-2026-03-15-pinned.tar.gz sha256: b7e9d5f2c3a4b6d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f67890abcdeffedcba1234567890abcdef
installer-v2.1.0-pinned.bin sha256: c3d5e7a9b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8
```

maria: Uploaded to s3://redwood-private/rcs/rc-2026-03-15/pinned/ and updated release notes.

seema: Extended canary 30m complete: three restarts observed across 3 nodes, but memory growth reduced compared to previous run. Marking canary as CONDITIONAL PASS — needs further repro on longer load.

oliver: Ok to proceed with limited rollout? Proposal: proceed to 20% of Dedicated pool for 2 hours, monitor mem/RSS, and be ready to rollback to images:v2.0.9 (we already have pin).

maria: Approved for limited rollout per oliver, with rollback playbook ready (steps in thread). Starting at 2026-03-16 22:15 UTC. devops-bot will execute.

devops-bot: Limited rollout scheduled: 2026-03-16 22:15-00:15 UTC. Canary state: pinned artifacts deployed. Alerts configured: mem_rss > 1.2x baseline -> auto-rollback.

deploy-bot: Rollback plan saved as runbook RB-20260315-01. Quick rollback command: `deployctl rollback --cluster private-dedicated --to-tag images:v2.0.9 --force` (requires 2 approvals).

josh: I'll draft the release note snippet about the pinned image and the reason (temporary memory regression) and link to the issue tracker.

maria: Thanks all. I'll update the release ticket with final artifact SHAs and close the packaging task once the limited rollout finishes without incident.

seema: Will keep monitoring and post final verdict.

maria: 👍
